limitations: This model specializes context.communications and grants no provider capability, approval, execution, readiness, verification, or health authority.

Only channel and channel-ingestion-policy are durable directory records in the first provider mapping; workspace, direct-message, thread, message, and participant remain portable semantics for bounded reads.

Every provider identity is reduced to an opaque scope-bound fingerprint before any portable Context record or Notion directory value is formed; raw provider workspace, conversation, thread, message, and participant IDs remain private runtime data.
Message content is private untrusted data and is never represented in the durable channel directory, general workspace inspection, evidence, fixtures, or logs.
A provider participant never becomes a CRM person or organization without a separate exact governed resolution; personUris and organizationUris contain only resolved Context resource identities.
Direct messages are modeled but excluded from the first collaboration conversation-review workflow.
